yoga poses that are good
for your health

1. child's pose

knees wide, forehead down, arms long.
stay for a few slow breaths.

2. downward dog

a long stretch from your hands to your heels.
bend your knees if you need to.

3. legs up the wall

this morning i learned that napoleon was about average height for his time.
i learned it lying like this. ten quiet minutes.

4. cat-cow

round your back, then arch it.
slowly, with your breath.

5. seated forward fold

reach, don't force.
go gently, always.
save this for your next quiet evening.
